claim_text: Human NK development through stages 1-5 in secondary lymphoid tissue (Freud/Caligiuri)

audit.primary_source_pmid: 16606675 (PMC2118285, doi 10.1084/jem.20052507) — PRIMARY for stages 1-4; 15780987 (doi 10.1016/j.immuni.2005.01.013) — antecedent for the stage-1 LN progenitor; NO primary source exists for "stage 5" (see notes)
audit.primary_source_citation: Freud AG, Yokohama A, Becknell B, Lee MT, Mao HC, Ferketich AK, Caligiuri MA. "Evidence for discrete stages of human natural killer cell differentiation in vivo." J Exp Med 2006;203(4):1033-1043. [THE primary source: stages 1-4 first defined here]. Antecedent: Freud AG, Becknell B, Roychowdhury S, Mao HC, Ferketich AK, Nuovo GJ, Hughes TL, Marburger TB, Sung J, Baiocchi RA, Guimond M, Caligiuri MA. "A human CD34(+) subset resides in lymph nodes and differentiates into CD56bright natural killer cells." Immunity 2005;22(3):295-304. Stage 5 appears only in REVIEWS (Freud & Caligiuri, Immunol Rev 2006;214:56-72, PMID 17100876; Yu, Freud & Caligiuri, Trends Immunol 2013;34:573-582, PMID 24055329; Freud, Mundy-Bosse, Yu & Caligiuri, Immunity 2017;47:820-833, PMID 29166586) — I searched and could not find any primary paper that established a stage 5 in secondary lymphoid tissue.
audit.fulltext_unavailable_reason: JEM 2006 (the actual primary source) full text INCLUDING complete Materials and Methods obtained from PMC and archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/D4_PMC2118285.txt — methods read in full, no substitution of abstract. Immunity 2005 (antecedent) is ABSTRACT_ONLY: not deposited in PMC, Elsevier paywall; cell.com fulltext returned HTTP 403 and doi.org redirect to linkinghub.elsevier.com returned only a "Redirecting" stub. Its Experimental Procedures were therefore NOT read and I make no methods-level claim about it. Counter-example Crellin 2010 obtained in full (/home/user/aaa/refs/D4_PMC2822607.txt). Montaldo 2014 (Immunity) and Wu 2018 (Sci Immunol) and Freud 2016 (Cell Rep) resolved to ABSTRACT_ONLY via PMC route; their methods are characterised from abstract + reference-level detail only and are flagged as such below.
audit.species: human (JEM 2006: human tonsil and lymph node only; no animal work in the primary source). The strongest COUNTER-evidence is rhesus macaque (Wu 2018).
audit.what_was_measured: In human secondary lymphoid tissue (tonsil and lymph node), CD3/CD19-depleted mononuclear cells were surface-stained for CD34, CD45RA, CD117 and CD94 and FACS-sorted to >99% purity into four cross-sectionally defined gates at a SINGLE ex vivo timepoint (no timecourse, no label, no tracer). Each sorted gate was then assayed for: ~15 surface markers by flow cytometry; CD34/CD122/ETS-1/GATA-3/T-BET transcript copy number by TaqMan qPCR normalised to 18S from >=2x10^4 sorted cells; 8-h luciferase-based lysis of K562 and Jurkat targets at E:T 20:1; 12-h IFN-gamma/GM-CSF/TNF-alpha/IL-13 ELISA after IL-12+IL-15+IL-18 or PMA+ionomycin+IL-2. Every stage-to-stage "transition" was then measured as the appearance of the downstream surface phenotype in CULTURE: 4 d to 5 wk in 200 uL wells in IL-15 (1 nM) with or without FL/IL-3/IL-7, on MS-5 stroma, on OP9-DL1 stroma, or with 10^4 sorted stage 3 or 4 cells plus 2.5x10^3 autologous anti-CD3/CD28-bead-activated tonsil T cells. Readout in every case = flow-cytometric re-phenotyping of the bulk well for CD34/CD117/CD94/CD56. Nothing was measured inside a human tissue over time; no cell was observed to convert.
audit.n: Whole study: >50 tonsil donors and 30 lymph node donors (pooled tissue per donor). Individual experiments are much smaller: MS-5 bulk expansion n=4 (P=0.004); methylcellulose CFU "three separate experiments"; limiting-dilution NKP frequency 10 replicate wells per dose across 6 doses; qPCR from >=2x10^4 sorted cells per population. Number of donors contributing to the critical stage 3 -> stage 4 activated-T-cell co-culture is NOT stated in the paper.
audit.n_unit: donors (human tonsil / lymph node tissue donors). NOT cells, NOT wells.
audit.controls: Present and non-trivial, but none of them controls the key inference. (1) Sort purity >99%. (2) qPCR methodological control: CD34 mRNA highest in PB CD34+ HPC, undetectable in stages 3-4 and PB CD56bright. (3) Reference populations: total PB CD34+ HPC and PB CD56bright NK. (4) Lineage-potential POSITIVE controls: PB CD34+ HPC for erythro-myeloid CFU; cord-blood CD34+CD19- HPC for MS-5 B-cell cultures. (5) Reverse-direction controls (the strongest ones): stage 2 cultures did not yield CD34+CD117- stage 1 cells, and stage 4 cultures did not yield stage 3 cells — an explicit attempt to exclude backward conversion. (6) Cytotoxicity mechanism controls: EGTA/MgCl2, anti-TRAIL, anti-FasL, isotype-matched mAb. (7) Statistics: paired t test on log-transformed data. WHAT IS MISSING: no CFSE/dye-dilution, no barcoding, no single-cell or clonal assay, no spike-in contamination control. The claim that stage-1-derived CD34+CD117+ cells were made de novo rather than being day-0 stage-2 contaminants rests on an MFI ARGUMENT ("cultured stage 2 cells displayed lowered CD34 expression than the CD34(+)CD117(+) cells that had been derived from stage 1"), not on a control. Crellin 2010 ran exactly the CFSE and clonal controls that are absent here, and got the opposite answer.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: SELECTION/OUTGROWTH OF A PRE-EXISTING MINOR SUBSET INSIDE AN UNDER-RESOLVED SORT GATE, PLUS CULTURE-IMPOSED PHENOTYPE CONVERSION. The stage gates are defined by only CD34/CD117/CD94, which cannot separate CD127+ RORC+ ILC3/LTi cells from CD127- committed NK precursors — both are Lin-CD34-CD117+CD94- and therefore both fall in "stage 3". Under this alternative, stage 3 is not a precursor state at all but a MIXTURE: a stable, self-renewing ILC3 lineage (the majority, which never becomes NK) plus a small CD127- NK-committed minority that simply expands in IL-15/DC/activated-T-cell culture. The bulk-well flow readout used throughout JEM 2006 cannot distinguish "stage 3 became stage 4" from "the 2% CD127- NK precursors in the stage 3 gate outgrew everything else". Freud's own data are consistent with selection rather than conversion: only "a small fraction (<=2%) of the sorted stage 3 cells were induced to express CD94" in IL-15, and stage 4 appeared only when extra non-physiological signals (OP9-DL1 Notch ligand, or anti-CD3/CD28-activated autologous T cells) were supplied. A second, compatible alternative is cytokine-driven ILC plasticity: IL-15/IL-12 can push RORgt+ ILC3 toward an NK-like/ILC1-like phenotype in vitro, so an in-culture phenotype switch is not evidence of a physiological developmental route. A third, independent alternative applies to the "in secondary lymphoid tissue" half of the claim: the intermediates may simply TRAFFIC through tonsil/LN rather than develop there — a possibility the authors themselves raise verbatim ("It is also unclear to what extent stage 4 cells, or any of the other NK cell lineage populations, actually arise within SLT or merely traffic through these tissues").
audit.counter_evidence: FOUND, and some of it is a STRONGER evidence class than the claim itself. (1) Crellin NK, Trifari S, Kaplan CD, Cupedo T, Spits H. "Human NKp44+IL-22+ cells and LTi-like cells constitute a stable RORC+ lineage distinct from conventional natural killer cells." J Exp Med 2010;207:281-290. PMID 20142432 / PMC2822607 — full methods read. Human tonsil; sorted Lin-CD117+CD127+ cells CFSE-labelled (the contamination control Freud lacked: CD56 was upregulated on CFSE-BRIGHT NON-DIVIDING cells, excluding outgrowth) and cloned by limiting dilution at 1 and 3 cells/well, 10-20 clones characterised from EACH OF 2 DONORS. Lines and single-cell clones retained RORC/AHR/CD117/IL-22 and LTi function and did NOT convert to cNK. Verbatim: "iNK cells, as defined by [Freud] and [Cella], may contain a mixture of LTi cells and immature cNK cells and do not necessarily contain common NK/LTi cell precursors" — i.e. the canonical SELECTION alternative, published, with clonal resolution. (2) Montaldo E et al. "Human RORgt(+)CD34(+) cells are lineage-specified progenitors of group 3 RORgt(+) innate lymphoid cells." Immunity 2014;41:988-1000. PMID 25500367 (abstract only). Tonsil + intestinal lamina propria: the RORgt+ fraction of the CD34+ gate (Freud's stage 2 territory) "selectively differentiated toward ILC3s"; only RORgt- CD34+ HPC were NK/ILC3 bipotent. Reframes stage 2 as an ILC3 progenitor. (3) Wu C, Espinoza DA, Koelle SJ, ... Bryceson YT, Dunbar CE. "Clonal expansion and compartmentalized maintenance of rhesus macaque NK cell subsets." Sci Immunol 2018;3:eaat9781. PMID 30389798 / PMC7393805 (abstract only; methods not obtainable via PMC). Autologous transplant of lentivirally BARCODED HSPCs in rhesus macaques, clonally tracked >4 years — genuine OBS_DIRECT lineage tracing, a strictly stronger class than anything supporting the claim. CD56-CD16+ (CD56dim-equivalent) NK clones "remained long-term clonally uncoupled from other hematopoietic lineages, INCLUDING CD56+CD16- NK cells", and the authors conclude "linear NK cell production from multipotent hematopoietic progenitors or less mature CD56+CD16- cells is negligible during homeostasis and moderate proliferative stress." This directly contradicts the stage 4 -> stage 5 step. Precursor paper: Wu C et al., Cell Stem Cell 2014;14:486-499, PMID 24702997, "highlights a distinct lineage origin for natural killer cells". (4) Tang Q, Ahn YO, Southern P, Blazar BR, Miller JS, Verneris MR. Blood 2011;117:4052-4055. PMID 21310921 — IL-22-producing NK-lineage cells develop from cord-blood HSC "in the absence of secondary lymphoid tissue", undercutting the "in SLT" clause. (5) Renoux VM et al. "Identification of a Human Natural Killer Cell Lineage-Restricted Progenitor in Fetal and Adult Tissues." Immunity 2015;43:394-407. PMID 26287684 — NK lineage restriction occurs in a progenitor that is not part of the SLT stage sequence. (6) Ahn YO, Blazar BR, Miller JS, Verneris MR. Blood 2013;121:2234-2243. PMID 23327921 — lineage relationship of IL-22+CD56+RORgt+ ILC vs cNK. (7) CONCESSION FROM WITHIN THE MODEL: Freud AG et al., Cell Rep 2016;16:379-391, PMID 27373165 — stage 4 had to be split because "stage 4a cells expressed more of the transcription factors RORgt and AHR and produced interleukin-22, similar to ... stage 3 cells, whose phenotype overlaps with that of group 3 innate lymphoid cells (ILC3s)". (8) Scoville, Freud & Caligiuri, Front Immunol 2017;8:360 concede: "it is not yet clear if stage 3 cells and ILC3s are entirely overlapping in their phenotypic characteristics, and this is a subject of ongoing investigation."
audit.downstream_dependency: CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCIES: (1) Hughes T, Briercheck EL, Freud AG, ... Caligiuri MA. "The Transcription Factor AHR Prevents the Differentiation of a Stage 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Subset to Natural Killer Cells." Cell Rep 2014;8:150-162, PMID 24953655 / PMC4133146 — the paper's entire thesis, its title, and the therapeutic proposal that AHR antagonism can be used to release NK output, all presuppose that stage 3 -> stage 4 is a real conversion. If stage 3 is a stable ILC3 lineage (Crellin 2010), the AHR result is a plasticity/culture-conversion result, not a developmental-checkpoint result. (2) Scoville SD, ... Freud AG, Caligiuri MA et al. "Identification and Targeting of the Developmental Blockade in Extranodal Natural Killer/T-cell Lymphoma." Blood Cancer Discov 2022;3:154-169, PMID 35247900 — stages the tumour against the Freud/Caligiuri ladder and proposes therapy aimed at releasing a "developmental blockade" at a specific stage; the stage assignment is only meaningful if the ladder is a real lineage sequence. (3) Hughes T et al. Immunity 2010;32:803-814 (PMID 20620944), whose central claim is that IL-1beta "expands and sustains" stage 3 cells and that removing IL-1beta lets "a substantially greater fraction of IL-1R1(hi) iNK cells differentiate to stage 4" — again a conversion claim built on the ladder. (4) Operationally, CD34+-HPC-derived NK-cell manufacturing for adoptive immunotherapy uses stage 1-5 surface phenotypes as its in-process QC roadmap for "maturity", so a wrong ladder mis-scores product maturity. Also note Freud AG et al., Methods Mol Biol 2010;612:1-14 (PMID 20033630) exists purely to teach other labs to purify these stages, propagating the framework.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED, SCOPE AND STATUS OVERTURNED. Claude's call of "INFERENCE (markers + in vitro)" survives the audit: the strongest class in the primary source is INF_INVITRO with INF_MARKER, and no OBS_* class supports the claim as stated. But the initial call is materially incomplete on three points that change what the row means. (a) STAGE 5 HAS NO PRIMARY SOURCE AT ALL. I searched for one and could not find it. It was explicit speculation in the JEM 2006 Discussion, in the authors' own words: "we speculate that PB CD56 dim NK cells might represent the terminally differentiated stage of human NK cell development (stage 5). However, we currently lack direct evidence to support this hypothesis and cannot yet formally exclude the possibility that PB CD56 bright and/or CD56 dim NK cells might be derived from distinct NKPs that differentiate in the BM." Stage 5 became a numbered box only in review figures. Worse, the claim locates stages 1-5 IN SECONDARY LYMPHOID TISSUE, but CD56dim/stage-5 cells are a small minority in tonsil/LN (CD56bright predominates there) and no stage 4 -> stage 5 transition was ever measured in SLT by anyone. So the claim as written is BROADER THAN ANY PRIMARY MEASUREMENT — this is not "weak evidence for the claim", it is "no primary evidence for the last step of the claim". (b) THE PAPER'S TITLE SAYS "IN VIVO" AND NO IN VIVO TRANSITION WAS OBSERVED. "In vivo" in the title refers only to where the cells were SAMPLED FROM. Every A->B step (1->2, 2->3, 3->4) is a bulk-culture flow readout. This is a textbook G1 trap and the initial call did not flag it. (c) THERE IS COUNTER-EVIDENCE OF A STRONGER CLASS THAN THE CLAIM ITSELF. Wu/Dunbar 2018 barcoded-HSPC clonal tracing in macaques (OBS_DIRECT) finds CD56bright- and CD56dim-equivalent NK subsets clonally uncoupled and states that linear production from less mature CD56+CD16- cells is "negligible" — i.e. the stage 4 -> 5 step is contradicted by lineage tracing, not merely unsupported. Crellin 2010 supplies CFSE + single-cell clonal data (the controls JEM 2006 lacked) showing the CD127+ majority of "stage 3" does not convert. The correct verdict is therefore stronger than "INFERENCE": the ladder is INF_INVITRO for steps 1->4, has NO primary source for step 4->5, is CONTRADICTED by OBS_DIRECT evidence at step 4->5, and is partially conceded by its own authors (stage 4a/4b split, 2016; "not yet clear if stage 3 cells and ILC3s are entirely overlapping", 2017).
audit.methods_quote: CLASSIFICATION-JUSTIFYING QUOTE (this is the entirety of how the stage 3 -> stage 4 step was produced): "Activated T cell co-culture experiments were performed in 200 microl of medium with 10^4 freshly isolated SLT stage 3 or 4 cells and 2.5 x 10^3 autologous SLT CD3(+) T cells (purified via sorting) with 5 x 10^3 anti-CD3/CD28 beads (Dynal) and IL-15." — Freud et al., J Exp Med 2006;203:1033-1043, MATERIALS AND METHODS, "Cell culture" (PMC2118285; archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D4_PMC2118285.txt). N-JUSTIFYING QUOTE: "The data in this study were generated from the combined analyses of tissue specimens from >50 tonsil and 30 LN donors and we observed no appreciable differences between LNs and tonsils by phenotype or functional assays." — same paper, MATERIALS AND METHODS, "Cell isolation from human tissues". AUTHORS' OWN LIMITATION, from the DISCUSSION of the same paper: "we speculate that PB CD56 dim NK cells might represent the terminally differentiated stage of human NK cell development (stage 5). However, we currently lack direct evidence to support this hypothesis"; and "It is also unclear to what extent stage 4 cells, or any of the other NK cell lineage populations, actually arise within SLT or merely traffic through these tissues." COUNTER-EXAMPLE METHODS QUOTE: "Lin - CD117 + CD127 + LTi-like cells were purified and cloned by limiting dilution at one and three cells per well of a 96-well round-bottomed plate. Approximately 8-10% of the wells seeded with one cell per well showed robust expansion and 10-20 clones from each donor were characterized further." — Crellin et al., J Exp Med 2010;207:281-290 (PMC2822607; archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D4_PMC2822607.txt).

audit.notes:
SCOPE NOTE ON evidence_types_all — each class annotated so nothing is inflated (G7): INF_INVITRO and INF_MARKER are the ONLY classes in the primary source (Freud JEM 2006) and are what the claim actually rests on; INF_KINETIC is present only weakly, as the "nonrandom, orderly acquisition of NK cell receptors" ordering across gates, which is a cross-sectional marker ordering, not a real timecourse; OBS_TRANSFER is present ONLY in a LATER, DIFFERENT paper (Freud 2016 Cell Rep, PMID 27373165: "transplantation into immunodeficient mice produced mature NK cells from stage 3 and stage 4a populations") — this is a XENOGENEIC transfer of human tonsil cells into a lymphopenic NOD/SCID/NSG mouse, it covers only stages 3 and 4a, it says nothing about stages 1, 2 or 5, and critically it demonstrates POTENCY IN A PERMISSIVE FOREIGN HOST, not that this route occurs in human secondary lymphoid tissue, so it does NOT raise the strongest class for the claim as stated; INF_TRAJECTORY appears only in later re-derivations of the ladder from scRNA-seq/pseudotime (e.g. Nat Immunol 2024, PMID 38956378) and per G2 is the WEAKEST class and cannot distinguish conversion from adjacency in expression space — it must not be counted as confirmation of the model.

THE HINT WAS ACCURATE AND I CONFIRMED IT: "tonsil/lymph node phenotyping plus in vitro differentiation" is exactly right, and the answer to "was any stage-to-stage transition observed in vivo in humans?" is NO — I searched specifically for human in vivo lineage tracing of these stages (somatic-mutation / clonal tracing query) and found none. The ILC3 controversy is real, documented, and partially conceded by the original authors.

TWO THINGS A CONSUMER OF THIS ROW SHOULD NOT MISREAD: (1) The primary source is a careful paper with good internal controls for its era (reverse-direction cultures, positive-control lineage assays, purity >99%) and its authors stated its limits explicitly in the Discussion. The problem is not sloppiness in the paper; it is the drift between what the paper measured (in vitro potency of four ex-vivo-sorted gates) and what the claim asserts (a five-stage developmental pathway occurring in secondary lymphoid tissue). (2) "NOT FOUND != DOES NOT EXIST" applies to one item here: I could not read the Methods of Freud Immunity 2005, Montaldo Immunity 2014, Wu Sci Immunol 2018 or Freud Cell Rep 2016 (paywalls / no PMC full text). For those four I characterise design from abstract + citing-paper detail only and flag it; I did NOT substitute an abstract for methods in the primary source, whose methods I read in full.

adv.challenge_reason: UPGRADE — the auditor's strongest-class call of INF_INVITRO rests on a factual error it declared openly: it recorded Freud 2016 Cell Rep (PMID 27373165 / PMC4970225) as ABSTRACT_ONLY and wrote "I make no methods-level claim about it." I obtained that paper's Experimental Procedures in full from the PMC web page (lit.py returns abstract-only for this PMCID; WebFetch on https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4970225/ returns the full methods). The methods describe a bona fide OBS_TRANSFER: "Six to ten week old female NSG mice were treated with 25 mg/kg busulfan one day prior to injection of purified human tonsil-derived cells"; "5E3 - 1E5 purified NK cell developmental intermediates were injected intravenously into the tail veins"; recipients received "intraperitoneal injections of recombinant human IL-15 (0.5 ug)" twice weekly; "Five weeks following transplantation, the mice were sacrificed, and their spleens, blood, and BM cells were harvested and then analyzed by flow cytometry", with "murine leukocytes ... excluded using an anti-mouse CD45.1 antibody" and "Human leukocytes ... identified with an anti-human CD45 antibody". Sorted gates were >99% pure on a FACSAriaII, with stage 5 explicitly sortable as Lin-CD94+NKp80+CD16+. Result: transplanted stage 3 and stage 4a cells "each showed evidence of downstream NK cell maturation", acquiring the Lin-CD94+NKp80+CD16+ stage-5 phenotype, stage 3 passing through 4a/4b; Fig 7A n=4 for the stage 3 transplant. So A was transferred and B was recovered from the recipient. That is OBS_TRANSFER by the taxonomy's own definition, and it falsifies BOTH of the auditor's two headline assertions: (i) "NO primary source exists for stage 5 / no primary evidence for the last step of the claim" is wrong — Freud 2016 both operationalises stage 5 as a sort gate and generates it in vivo from stage 3 and 4a; (ii) the auditor's own scope note "[the transfer] covers only stages 3 and 4a, it says nothing about stages 1, 2 or 5" is wrong on stage 5, since stage 5 is precisely the readout endpoint. The auditor demoted a class it had not read the methods for, which is the mirror-image of a G1 violation. HOWEVER the upgrade is strictly bounded and does NOT rescue the claim as worded: (a) it covers stages 3->4->5 only; stages 1->2->3 remain INF_INVITRO (bulk MS-5/OP9-DL1/IL-15 wells, flow re-phenotyping of the well); (b) the host is a busulfan-myeloablated, lymphopenic, xenogeneic NSG mouse on continuous exogenous human IL-15, and the progeny were recovered from mouse spleen/blood/BM — nothing was measured in human secondary lymphoid tissue, so the "in SLT" clause of the claim is still supported by nothing above INF_MARKER (cross-sectional presence of the gates in tonsil/LN); (c) 5e3-1e5 cells were transferred in bulk at >99% (not 100%) purity — up to ~500 contaminating cells at the top dose — with no barcoding, no CFSE, no clonal or limiting-dilution transfer, so the transfer does NOT exclude outgrowth of a pre-existing minority and is not OBS_DIRECT. I also independently re-read the JEM 2006 methods (/home/user/aaa/refs/D4_PMC2118285.txt) and confirm the auditor's characterisation of that paper is otherwise accurate, with one further factual correction: the auditor wrote "no single-cell or clonal assay" among missing controls, but JEM 2006 DID run a clonal-resolution limiting-dilution assay ("Purified stage 1 and 2 cells were cultured at 50, 25, 12.5, 6.25, 3.125, and 1.5625 cells per well, 10 replicates each, on MS-5 stroma"). That correction cuts AGAINST the model, not for it: the reported NKP frequencies are 1/44-1/37 (stage 1, IL-15 alone), 1/14-1/9 (stage 1 + FL/IL-3/IL-7) and <1/3.5 (stage 2) — i.e. by the paper's own clonal assay only ~2-11% of the stage 1 gate has NK potential, which is exactly what "an under-resolved gate is a mixture and a minority was selected" predicts. No OBS_GENETIC and no OBS_DIRECT anywhere. Net: strongest class rises INF_INVITRO -> OBS_TRANSFER for the 3->4->5 segment; the claim's weakest link moves from "no evidence at all for stage 5" to "xenogeneic, non-clonal, bulk evidence for stage 5 that cannot discriminate conversion from selection."
adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest: OBS_TRANSFER (xenogeneic, bulk, non-clonal) — Freud AG et al., Cell Rep 2016;16:379-391, PMID 27373165 / PMC4970225: 5e3-1e5 FACS-sorted (>99% pure) human tonsil stage 3 or stage 4a cells injected IV into busulfan-conditioned NSG mice + hIL-15 IP twice weekly, harvested at 5 wk, human CD45+ progeny re-phenotyped by flow in spleen/blood/BM, yielding Lin-CD94+NKp80+CD16+ "stage 5" (Fig 7A n=4). SEGMENT-RESOLVED: stages 3->4->5 = OBS_TRANSFER; stages 1->2->3 = INF_INVITRO (Freud JEM 2006, PMID 16606675); the "occurs IN secondary lymphoid tissue" clause = INF_MARKER only (cross-sectional CD34/CD117/CD94 gating of tonsil/LN at a single ex vivo timepoint, no label, no tracer, no timecourse). Full class list present across the evidence base, annotated so nothing is inflated: OBS_TRANSFER (Freud 2016 NSG, methods read; also claimed by Chan 2007 PMID 17579025 "transfer into NOD-SCID mice" but its methods are paywalled at academic.oup.com and I make NO methods-level claim about it); INF_INVITRO (JEM 2006, every 1->2, 2->3, 3->4 step, bulk-well flow readout); INF_MARKER; INF_KINETIC (weak — cross-sectional receptor ordering, not a timecourse); INF_TRAJECTORY (only in later scRNA-seq re-derivations, per G2 the weakest class and not confirmation). ZERO OBS_DIRECT and ZERO OBS_GENETIC support the claim; the only OBS_DIRECT-class evidence in this area (Wu 2018 macaque barcoding; Ding 2024 PLZF fate map; Flommersfeld 2021 single-cell fate map) all runs AGAINST it.
adv.new_counter_evidence: FOUR items the auditor missed, one of which is more targeted than anything in its counter-evidence list. (1) **Ding Y, Lavaert M, Grassmann S, ... Bhandoola A. "Distinct developmental pathways generate functionally distinct populations of natural killer cells." Nat Immunol 2024;25:1183-1192. PMID 38872000 / PMC12338846** — THE major miss. Methods obtained from the PMC page: PLZF-Cre Rosa26-YFP genetic fate mapping plus transfer of "PLZF-YFP- ENKPs, PLZF-YFP- ILCPs or PLZF-YFP- ALPs from PLZF-Cre Rosa26-YFP reporter mice into NSG recipient mice", and chimeras from "CD45.2+PLZF-YFP-Lin-Kit+ hematopoietic progenitors ... into lethally irradiated CD45.1+ wild-type mice". ~70% of ILCP-derived NK were PLZF-YFP+ vs only ~10% of ENKP-derived NK: TWO INDEPENDENT NK developmental pathways, an NK-lineage-biased ENKP that develops "independently of common precursors for innate lymphoid cells". Crucially for D4: "Human CD56dim and CD56bright NK cells were transcriptionally similar to ENKP_NK cells and ILCP_NK cells, respectively" — i.e. the canonical TWO-INDEPENDENT-ORIGINS alternative applied precisely to the stage 4 (CD56bright) -> stage 5 (CD56dim) step, from genuine OBS_DIRECT + OBS_TRANSFER mouse data. Honest limit (G1): the human half is CITE-seq/scRNA-seq reanalysis of published datasets with "no experimental manipulation of human cells", so for humans it is INF_MARKER/INF_TRAJECTORY, not falsification — but it supplies a mechanistically specified alternative that Freud's bulk data cannot exclude. (2) **Flommersfeld S, ... Buchholz VR, Grassmann S. "Fate mapping of single NK cells identifies a type 1 innate lymphoid-like lineage that bridges innate and adaptive recognition of viral infection." Immunity 2021;54:2288-2304. PMID 34437840 / PMC8528403** (full text archived /home/user/aaa/refs/PMC8528403.txt) — single-cell fate mapping in MCMV: cells "currently ... thought to differentiate along a common pathway" resolved into "two distinct NK cell lineages", one cNK-equivalent and one ILC1-like with splenic residency. Same structural refutation, at single-cell fate-mapping resolution: an assumed single ladder was two lineages. (3) **Dogra P, ... Farber DL. "Tissue Determinants of Human NK Cell Development, Function, and Residence." Cell 2020;180:749-763. PMID 32059780 / PMC7194029** — 60 human organ donors, blood + lymphoid organs + mucosa: "precursor and immature NK cells with reduced effector capacity populate lymph nodes and intestines and exhibit TISSUE-RESIDENT signatures and site-specific adaptations", while mature/terminally differentiated NK "predominate in blood, bone marrow, spleen, and lungs". A tissue-RESIDENCY explanation for the SLT enrichment of stages 1-4 competes directly with a transit/development explanation, and it is the alternative Freud himself flagged ("merely traffic through these tissues") — now with 60-donor human data behind it. The auditor did not cite it. (4) **Freud 2006's own clonal data** (missed by the auditor, who wrote that no clonal assay was done): limiting dilution gives NKP frequencies of 1/44-1/37 and 1/14-1/9 for stage 1 and <1/3.5 for stage 2 — so 89-98% of the stage 1 gate produced no NK cells. Self-contradicting evidence for gate heterogeneity, from the primary source. NOT REPLICATED / NOT FOUND, stated honestly: I searched for a published FAILED REPLICATION of the Freud stage series and for human in vivo lineage tracing of these stages (somatic-mutation / mtDNA clonal tracing) — searches run and read, zero on-point hits. Per G3 that is NOT_FOUND, not "does not exist."
adv.crossfield_g4_findings: The borrowed process is "a discrete differentiation ladder inferred from surface-marker sort gates plus in vitro/transfer output." That grammar has been tested to destruction in three neighbouring fields, and D4 has not survived any of those tests. **HEMATOPOIETIC-PROGENITOR / MYELOID HOME FIELD — the fatal collision.** Karamitros D et al., "Single-cell analysis reveals the continuum of human lympho-myeloid progenitor cells," Nat Immunol 2018;19:85-97, PMID 29167569 / PMC5884424: the human LMPP, GMP and MLP gates — built by exactly Freud's method (FACS gate + in vitro lineage output) — "were functionally and transcriptionally distinct and HETEROGENEOUS AT THE CLONAL LEVEL, with progenitors of many different functional potentials present. Although MOST progenitors had the potential to develop into only one mature cell type ('uni-lineage potential')..." and the authors conclude for "a continuum of progenitors ... rather than only uni-lineage progenitors' being present downstream of stem cells." This is the canonical, empirically proven instance of the exact alternative that applies to Freud's stage gates: bulk output from a marker gate is the SUM OF A MIXTURE, and the gate's apparent multipotency/progression evaporates at clonal resolution. Notta F et al., Science 2016;351:aab2116, PMID 26541609, "Distinct routes of lineage development reshape the human blood hierarchy across ontogeny," dissolved the discrete CMP stage the same way. Ginhoux F et al., Science 2010;330:841-845, PMID 20966214: in vivo fate mapping showed microglia/tissue macrophages are NOT the terminal rung of a monocyte ladder but a separate yolk-sac origin — a marker-and-culture-inferred ladder was wrong about ORIGIN, not merely about order. Schlitzer A et al., Nat Immunol 2015;16:718-728, PMID 26054720: cDC1 and cDC2 commitment already exists INSIDE the "common DC progenitor" gate — a gate that read as one upstream stage was pre-committed heterogeneity. Bearing on D4: every one of these says that Freud's stage 3 gate (Lin-CD34-CD117+CD94-, three markers) is expected a priori to be a mixture, and that bulk output from it cannot be read as conversion. **T CELL FIELD.** Buchholz VR et al., "Disparate individual fates compose robust CD8+ T cell immunity," Science 2013;340:630-635, PMID 23493420, and Gerlach C et al., "Heterogeneous differentiation patterns of individual CD8+ T cells," Science 2013;340:635-639, PMID 23493421: in vivo single-cell fate mapping showed that a smooth population-level "linear differentiation" curve is an ARTEFACT OF AVERAGING over individual cells with non-overlapping fates — the population trajectory belongs to no single cell. Bearing on D4: both of Freud's readouts (bulk-well flow re-phenotyping in JEM 2006; bulk 5e3-1e5-cell xenotransfer in Cell Rep 2016) are population averages of exactly the kind the T cell field demonstrated can be generated without any individual cell traversing the ladder. **ILC FIELD — the mechanistic collision.** Vonarbourg C, Mortha A, ... Diefenbach A, "Regulated expression of nuclear receptor RORgammat confers distinct functional fates to NK cell receptor-expressing RORgammat(+) innate lymphocytes," Immunity 2010;33:736-751, PMID 21093318 / PMC3042726: "By using ADOPTIVE TRANSFER OF GENETICALLY TAGGED LTi-like cells, we demonstrate that NKR-RORgammat(+) innate lymphocytes BUT NOT NK CELLS were direct progenitors to NKR(+)RORgammat(+) cells in vivo. GENETIC LINEAGE TRACING revealed that the differentiation of LTi-like cells was characterized by the stable upregulation of NKRs and a progressive loss of RORgammat expression. Whereas IL-7 and intestinal microbiota stabilized RORgammat expression within such NKR-LTi cells, **IL-12 AND IL-15 ACCELERATED RORgammat LOSS**." This is the borrowed mechanism's home-field kill shot and it is invisible to NK keywords. IL-15 at 1 nM is in EVERY culture in Freud JEM 2006 and is injected into every NSG recipient in Freud 2016; IL-12+IL-15+IL-18 is the stimulation cocktail. The ILC field's genetic fate mapping says those are precisely the cytokines that extinguish RORgammat and drive NK-receptor acquisition in an RORgammat+ innate lymphocyte — so "stage 3 cells acquire CD94 in IL-15" is the EXPECTED output of a cytokine-driven plasticity rheostat, and its fate-mapped in vivo endpoint is an IFN-gamma-producing, colitogenic ILC1, NOT a conventional NK cell. It also adjudicates between Crellin 2010 (stage 3 is a stable non-converting lineage) and Freud (stage 3 converts): the fate-mapping answer is that it converts but the destination is wrong, which is worse for D4 than either.

adv.load_bearing_reason: HIGH stands, but the auditor's list needs one item struck and one item added. VERIFIED AND GENUINELY LOAD-BEARING: (1) Hughes T, Briercheck EL, Freud AG, ... Caligiuri MA, "The transcription factor AHR prevents the differentiation of a stage 3 innate lymphoid cell subset to natural killer cells," Cell Rep 2014;8:150-162, PMID 24953655 (confirmed present via lit.py search; archived under D1_PMC4133146.txt). The paper's title, thesis and the AHR-antagonist translational proposal are all definitionally void if stage 3 -> stage 4 is not a real conversion; under Vonarbourg 2010 (PMID 21093318) the same result reads as an RORgammat/AHR plasticity rheostat whose in vivo destination is ILC1, not cNK. (2) Scoville SD et al., "Identification and Targeting of the Developmental Blockade in Extranodal Natural Killer/T-cell Lymphoma," Blood Cancer Discov 2022;3:154-169, doi 10.1158/2643-3230.BCD-21-0098, PMC9414823 — VERIFIED to exist and verified to be ladder-dependent: its central finding is that "neoplastic NK cells are stably, but reversibly, arrested at earlier stages of NK-cell maturation," with an EZH2/polycomb therapeutic hypothesis built on top. This is the strongest dependency because it converts the ladder into a clinical staging axis AND a drug rationale: "reversibly arrested at an earlier stage" is only a coherent therapeutic target if the stages form a real sequence a cell can be released along. (3) Hughes T et al., Immunity 2010;32:803-814, PMID 20620944 — IL-1beta "expands and sustains" stage 3 and its removal lets more iNK "differentiate to stage 4"; a conversion claim built directly on the ladder. ADD (the auditor missed this, and it is arguably the largest downstream cost): the ladder's stage-3 = "immature NK" label is the origin of a decade of NK-versus-ILC3 misassignment in the human literature — Crellin 2010 (PMID 20142432) says so verbatim ("iNK cells, as defined by [Freud] and [Cella], may contain a mixture of LTi cells and immature cNK cells"), Montaldo 2014 (PMID 25500367) reassigns the CD34+RORgammat+ fraction to ILC3, and Freud's own group had to split stage 4 into 4a/4b in 2016 (PMID 27373165) because stage 4a "expressed more of the transcription factors RORgammat and AHR and produced interleukin-22, similar to ... stage 3 cells, whose phenotype overlaps with that of group 3 innate lymphoid cells." Every human tonsil study that gated "iNK" on the Freud scheme inherits that ambiguity. STRIKE: the auditor's item (4), "CD34+-HPC-derived NK-cell manufacturing for adoptive immunotherapy uses stage 1-5 surface phenotypes as its in-process QC roadmap." I did not find support for this and the auditor cited none; NK cell-therapy products are released on CD56/CD16/NKG2A/KIR expression and functional cytotoxicity/IFN-gamma assays, not on stage 1-5 assignment. That item was generous and should not be counted. Freud et al., Methods Mol Biol 2010;612:1-14 (PMID 20033630) is real but is framework propagation, not a dependency with consequences.
adv.better_primary_source: PARTIALLY — the auditor's primary source for stages 1-4 is correct (Freud AG et al., J Exp Med 2006;203:1033-1043, PMID 16606675, PMC2118285, doi 10.1084/jem.20052507; methods re-read in full at /home/user/aaa/refs/D4_PMC2118285.txt), and Freud 2005 Immunity (PMID 15780987, doi 10.1016/j.immuni.2005.01.013) remains the correct antecedent for the stage-1 LN progenitor (still paywalled; methods NOT obtained; no methods-level claim made). BUT the auditor's central negative finding is wrong and must be corrected: it stated "NO primary source exists for stage 5" and "no primary evidence for the last step of the claim." The primary source for the stage 4 -> stage 5 step is **Freud AG, Keller KA, Scoville SD, ... Caligiuri MA. "NKp80 Defines a Critical Step during Human Natural Killer Cell Development." Cell Rep 2016;16(2):379-391. PMID 27373165 / PMC4970225 / doi 10.1016/j.celrep.2016.05.095** — this is the paper that first operationalises stage 5 as a sortable gate (Lin-CD94+NKp80+CD16+, >99% purity, FACSAriaII) and first produces it in vivo, by transplanting 5e3-1e5 sorted human tonsil stage 3 or stage 4a cells IV into busulfan-conditioned NSG mice with hIL-15 support and recovering human CD45+ stage-5-phenotype NK from spleen/blood/BM at 5 weeks (Fig 7A n=4). Its full Experimental Procedures ARE obtainable via https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4970225/ even though lit.py reports ABSTRACT_ONLY for that PMCID — the auditor's fulltext_unavailable_reason is therefore incorrect for this paper and its methods-level demotion of OBS_TRANSFER was made without reading the methods. One earlier candidate exists and I flag it honestly rather than counting it: Chan A, Hong D-L, Atzberger A, Kollnberger S, Filer AD, Buckley CD, McMichael A, Enver T, Bowness P, "CD56bright human NK cells differentiate into CD56dim cells: role of contact with peripheral fibroblasts," J Immunol 2007;179:89-94, PMID 17579025 — its abstract reports differentiation "in vivo, upon transfer into NOD-SCID mice," which if the methods bear it out would predate Freud 2016 as the first OBS_TRANSFER for the CD56bright->CD56dim (stage 4 -> 5) step. I attempted the full text at doi.org/10.4049/jimmunol.179.1.89 and at the academic.oup.com redirect target and hit a hard paywall; the Materials and Methods were NOT obtained, so per G1 I make no methods-level claim about it and do not classify from its abstract. Finally, note the scope caveat that survives every correction: none of these papers measured anything inside human secondary lymphoid tissue over time, so no primary source establishes the "in SLT" clause of claim D4 at any evidence class above INF_MARKER.
